subject: ui
title: The editor's Swarm tab and highlight and ask
note: The editor's right dock gains a Swarm tab (journal timeline, claims, board, review, cost) and a claim map in the viewport; the human highlights a statue and asks the agents to change its head in an engine-owned box, an agent does it, and the human approves it in the review screen. After two reviews: row labels wrap inside the dock, the window's Review tab is not drawn over the editor's status bar, and a screen that takes the window while the human types has its focus on Close.
